project.description: Enterprise FHIR-compliant telehealth portal with real-time patient telemetry, prescription routing, and EHR integration.

requirements.title: NIST SP 800-63A IAL2 Identity Verification

requirements.title: EDI 837P Healthcare Claim Generation

requirements.title: Secure Direct Messaging via DirectTrust

requirements.title: Bi-directional Epic MyChart Bridge
requirements.desc: SMART-on-FHIR OAuth 2.0 backend services handshake with Epic Systems EHR instances.

requirements.title: 15-Minute Inactive Session Timeout
requirements.desc: Automatic session invalidation and memory zeroing on client idle to prevent unattended PHI breach.

requirements.title: Cross-Region Encrypted Backup Replication
requirements.desc: RPO < 15 minutes, RTO < 1 hour for all clinical PostgreSQL database clusters.

requirements.title: DICOM Web Viewer Integration
requirements.desc: WADO-RS streaming viewer for PACS radiology scans with client-side contrast adjustment.

requirements.title: HL7 v2.5.1 ORU-R01 Result Parsing

codeFindings.desc: Cleartext logging of patient SSN and Date of Birth in debug print trace.
Raw SQL string concatenation in dynamic medical record filter query.
Hardcoded OAuth client_secret fallback detected in repository source.
Improper authentication: WebRTC consultation room token lacks expiry timestamp check.
Session fixation vulnerability during privilege escalation from patient to proxy.
Improper sanitization of clinician RichText notes leading to potential Stored XSS.
Improper restriction of XML External Entity Reference (XXE) in lab parser.
Internal database stack trace exposed in HTTP 500 error responses.
Internal inter-pod metrics communication does not require mutual TLS.
Password minimum length configured to 8 characters; NIST recommends 12 for health workers.
God class: PatientRecord contains 74 attributes and 29 helper methods.
Dead code: Deprecated ICD-9 conversion mapping table unused since 2024.
Duplicated filter logic across Patient, Encounter, and Procedure search endpoints.
Magic numbers used for systolic and diastolic hypertension alarm boundaries.
N+1 query pattern in Patient query fetching diagnostic reports iteratively.
Synchronous HTTP loop fetching payer verification tokens serially.
Unbuffered memory read of 250MB CT scan slice array.
Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) in clinic webhook notification endpoint.

vulnerabilities.title: Cleartext Storage of Sensitive Information in File System
vulnerabilities.desc: Patient identifier and PHI written into unencrypted application log stream.

vulnerabilities.title: SQL Injection in EHR Filter Query
vulnerabilities.desc: Unsanitized user search input concatenated into medical chart queries.

vulnerabilities.title: Use of Hard-coded Credentials
vulnerabilities.desc: Static production client secret committed in Epic Systems integration bridge.

vulnerabilities.title: Improper Authentication in WebRTC Room Allocation
vulnerabilities.desc: Telehealth consultation tokens can be replayed indefinitely.

vulnerabilities.title: Session Fixation in Clinical Proxy Switching
vulnerabilities.desc: Caregiver session tokens retain clinician authority upon role switch.

vulnerabilities.title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation
vulnerabilities.desc: Clinical narrative markdown rendering allows script injection via patient note.

vulnerabilities.title: Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference
vulnerabilities.desc: HL7 XML parser allows external file retrieval via DTD entity expansion.

vulnerabilities.title: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF)
vulnerabilities.desc: Clinic webhook callback URLs lack private IP range blacklist filtering.

vulnerabilities.title: Generation of Error Message Containing Sensitive Information
vulnerabilities.desc: SQL syntax errors return schema details in REST payload.

vulnerabilities.title: Cleartext Transmission of Sensitive Information
vulnerabilities.desc: Internal telemetry stream unencrypted within Kubernetes service mesh.

reports.title: HIPAA Security & OCR Audit Readiness Assessment

reports.summary: 100% pass rate on standard FHIR profiles (Patient, Observation, Condition). Ready for CMS interoperability rule deadline.

reports.title: Telehealth SFU Scalability & Encryption Benchmarking
reports.summary: Media infrastructure sustained 2,500 simultaneous WebRTC sessions with 0 DTLS packet drop and sub-80ms latency.
